new_en: You search the museum and find 'Bleeding Ward' again.

You take in its extravagant display. The reds of the moon seem to churn in the sky as the water glistens below. You think back on Winter's story. Mother goose and the blitz. The children <<= C.npc.Winter.pronoun is "m" ? "she" : "he">> took in. How later Winter met 'Summer', and how Winter was given the painting as a parting gift.
You also recall how Winter dodged and avoided speaking about what really happened with 'Summer'.
<<link [[Try to joke with Winter|Museum Breeding Ward Joke]]>><</link>>
/* Makes a list of antiques currently in the museum to randomize the antique Winter is looking at */

You search the museum for Winter and find <<him>> admiring <<print either(_antiqueMuseum)>>. <<He>> sees you approaching and greets you. "Hello, and what brings you here today?" <<he>> says, turning away from the display.
"I was hoping if you weren't busy you could tell me the story of 'Breeding Ward' again," you say quietly.
"Hey, Winter. Mind telling me about 'Breeding Ward' again?" You smirk to stop from laughing at your own joke.
"Do you have time to tell me the story behind 'Breeding Ward' again?" you say, smiling at your own joke.
<<He>> squints and looks at you incredulously. "I believe I misheard you. What did you say?"
Something in Winter's expression gives you pause. You realise <<he>> may not be as amused as you are.
<<link [[Don't|Museum Bleeding Ward Story]]>><<endevent>><<set $daily.breedingWard to true>><<set $daily.winterStoryTime to true>><</link>>

You take a breath and commit. Raising your voice you answer Winter. "Please tell me about the 'Breeding W-Ward' again." You stumble over the words, but you feel a sense of pride in having committed to your joke.

Winter's reaction pushes you over the edge and you laugh loudly. A <<personsimple>> looks over at your sudden outburst. Winter doesn't look nearly as amused. You make sure to enunciate each syllable this time.
"I said 'Breeding Ward'. I want to hear the story again, but this time don't skip the steamy details."
You won't back down. You clear your throat and try to enunciate. "I want you to tell me about 'Breeding Ward' again." You smile again and turn to Winter for <> reaction.

Winter's face reddens and <<he>> looks at you with a mixture of disappointment and frustration. "I'm too busy for this," <<he>> turns to walk away. "You can come back when you're serious." <<npcincr Winter love -1>><<llove>>
